#include <assert.h>

static int32_t c_visitor_visitor_skip_links_visit_link(const HTMHtmContext* _ctx, void* _user_data, const char* _href, const char* _text, const char* _title, char** out_custom, size_t* out_len) {
    (void)_ctx;
    (void)_user_data;
    (void)out_custom;
    (void)out_len;
    (void)_href;
    (void)_text;
    (void)_title;
    return 2;
}

int main(void) {

    /* Visitor skips all links entirely */

    HTMHtmVisitorCallbacks _callbacks;
    memset(&_callbacks, 0, sizeof(_callbacks));
    _callbacks.visit_link = c_visitor_visitor_skip_links_visit_link;

    HTMAlefHandle _visitor = htm_visitor_create(&_callbacks);
    assert(_visitor != 0 && "visitor create failed");

    HTMAlefHandle _options = htm_conversion_options_from_json("{}");
    assert(_options != 0 && "options from_json failed");

    htm_options_set_visitor(_options, _visitor);

    HTMAlefHandle _result = htm_convert("<p>Before <a href=\"https://example.com\">link text</a> after</p>", _options);
    assert(_result != 0 && "visitor call failed");

    htm_conversion_result_free(_result);
    htm_conversion_options_free(_options);
    htm_visitor_free(_visitor);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
